title: Crosstalk between the Wnt signaling pathway and axon guidance molecules reveals a novel signature for accurately predicting diagnosis, prognosis, and immune landscape in colorectal cancer.
authors: Zhao, Wenyi; Li, Tiegang; Zong, Jinbao; Zhang, Fang; Zhou, Mingxuan; Hou, Yufang; Yan, Zheng; Lv, Silin; Zeng, Zifan; Yang, Liu; Che, Yuexia; Ren, Xinyi; Zhou, Yixin; Zhu, Zengni; Yang, Min
one_liner_zh: 该文基于RNA测序构建Wnt信号与轴突导向基因签名预测结直肠癌诊断预后及免疫微环境，属纯转录组生物信息学与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Although the Wnt signaling pathway and axon guidance molecules are critical players in the malignant progression of colorectal cancer (CRC), their specific implications in CRC remain uncertain. This study aimed to construct a novel gene signature related to Wnt signaling and axon guidance genes signature (WARGsSig) to predict diagnosis, prognosis, and immune microenvironment in patients with CRC. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Utilizing RNA-sequencing data from a liver metastasis model of CRC in C57BL/6J mice, along with RNA sequencing data from various CRC cohorts, a novel WARGsSig model was developed and validated. These signatures were evaluated for their associations with diagnosis, prognosis, clinical features, biological pathways, and immune landscape, using multiple machine learning algorithms and diverse bioinformatics methods. The expression levels of WARGsSig were measured by quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction and immunohistochemistry (IHC). Tissue microarray (TMA) analysis was performed to determine the association between ventral anterior homeobox 2 (VAX2) expression and clinical outcomes of CRC patients by IHC. We also investigated the functional role and molecular mechanism of VAX2 using small interfering RNA in vitro . RESULTS: The WARGsSig exhibited strong diagnostic accuracy and was an independent prognostic factor, with low-risk patients showing improved survival. It was also correlated with immune cell infiltration. VAX2, the gene with the highest hazard ratio in the signature, was overexpressed in the CRC-TMA cohort and associated with poor prognosis. Functional experiments showed that VAX2 knockdown inhibited CRC cells' proliferation, migration, and invasion, and induced apoptosis, while VAX2 overexpression reversed the effects. Mechanistic studies indicated that VAX2 cooperatively regulates downstream genes within Wnt signaling and axon guidance pathways to promote epithelial-mesenchymal transition. CONCLUSION: The WARGsSig provides a potential tool for predicting diagnosis, prognosis, molecular subtypes, and immune context in CRC. These findings offer mechanistic insights and a foundation for future research, with promising implications for risk stratification and personalized treatment strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景：尽管Wnt信号通路和轴突导向分子在结直肠癌（CRC）的恶性进展中扮演关键角色，但它们对CRC的具体影响仍不确定。本研究旨在构建一个与Wnt信号和轴突导向基因相关的新型基因签名（WARGsSig），以预测CRC患者的诊断、预后和免疫微环境。材料与方法：利用C57BL/6J小鼠CRC肝转移模型的RNA测序数据，以及多个CRC队列的RNA测序数据，开发并验证了一个新型WARGsSig模型。通过多种机器学习算法和多种生物信息学方法，评估了这些签名与诊断、预后、临床特征、生物学通路和免疫景观的关联。通过定量实时聚合酶链反应和免疫组织化学（IHC）测量WARGsSig的表达水平。进行组织微阵列（TMA）分析，通过IHC确定腹侧前部同源盒2（VAX2）表达与CRC患者临床结局的关联。我们还使用小干扰RNA在体外研究了VAX2的功能作用和分子机制。结果：WARGsSig表现出强大的诊断准确性，并且是一个独立的预后因素，低风险患者的生存率有所提高。它还与免疫细胞浸润相关。VAX2是签名中风险比最高的基因，在CRC-TMA队列中过表达，并与不良预后相关。功能实验表明，VAX2敲低抑制了CRC细胞的增殖、迁移和侵袭，并诱导凋亡，而VAX2过表达则逆转了这些效应。机制研究表明，VAX2协同调控Wnt信号和轴突导向通路中的下游基因，以促进上皮-间质转化。结论：WARGsSig为预测CRC的诊断、预后、分子亚型和免疫环境提供了一个潜在工具。这些发现提供了机制见解和未来研究的基础，对风险分层和个性化治疗策略具有广阔前景。
